summary: Invokes VTableBooleanTestWrapper(a1, 140) and returns true only when the vtable-mediated boolean test yields zero (negated boolean).

operations.description: Calls VTableBooleanTestWrapper(a1, 140), a vtable-dispatched boolean test with selector value 140.
Compares the wrapper result against 0, inverting the boolean.
Returns true when the wrapper test returned zero, otherwise false.

unresolved: Meaning of the selector literal 140 passed to VTableBooleanTestWrapper is unknown; caller context suggests a readiness or state query (callers include NetComm_SetSelfAsReady, ConditionalRenderStateUpdate, SessionTypeSetter).
